So Sad So Sexy (stylized in all lowercase) is the fourth studio album by Swedish singer Lykke Li, released on 8 June 2018 by RCA. The album was preceded by the release of the singles "Deep End", "Hard Rain", "Utopia", "Sex Money Feelings Die" and "Two Nights" featuring Aminé "Aminé (rapper)"). Ilsey Juber co-wrote the majority of the album, which is musically influenced by trap. ## Release and promotion

Lykke Li announced So Sad So Sexy on 19 April alongside the release of the first two singles from the record, "Deep End" and "Hard Rain". She released the third single "Utopia" on Mother's Day with an intimate video directed by Clara Cullen. On 29 May, she released two more singles, "Sex Money Feelings Die" and "Two Nights" featuring Aminé "Aminé (rapper)"). On 10 April, Li shared a trailer for the album featuring a snippet of the title track, which Clash "Clash (magazine)") called a "silken pop groove that display[s] Lykke at her effortless best".
